name: Landgasthof-Ferienwohnung Pfarrwirt
beschreibung: The holiday apartments at Landgasthof Pfarrwirt welcome vacationers to idyllic Thiersee in the Kufstein district, located just a short walk from the pristine lake shore. This traditional country inn combines authentic family hospitality with contemporary self-catering amenities. Tastefully decorated apartments feature fully equipped kitchenettes, restful bedrooms, and private balconies framing panoramic views over Lake Thiersee and the Kaisergebirge. In the neighboring inn parlor, guests can enjoy hearty Tyrolean comfort dining. A sunny garden lawn provides peaceful relaxation, making it a perfect base for swimming, hiking, and winter sports.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming holiday apartments at Landgasthof Pfarrwirt in Thiersee offering lake views, gardens, and comfort.
